main_body: Wooden column: a wide rounded cap at the top (rows 8-16), a slim shaft with two gold bands (rows 17-39), and a flared base (rows 40-47).
top_band: Light tan/orange ellipse cap, rows 9-12 (L 126-153), wider than the shaft and rounded at the corners. Below it, rows 13-14 are a darker front lip (L 73-99), then a dark shadow at rows 15-16.
evidence: In the x=8 column, rows 9-12 form a clearly lighter ellipse top (L 126-153) on a cap wider than the shaft, 4 rows tall. The step to the darker lip at rows 13-14 (L 99/73) is over 25 L, and the dark rows 15-16 act as an eave shadow. The shaft below (L 73-99) is cylindrically shaded and much darker than the cap. This matches the guide's green ellipse-cap column, so it passes rule 12. The base is a similar flared ellipse, though a small one.

style.evidence: The wood ramp has about 6 steps (#c8904a, #a8753b, #895b2c, #69411d, #4f2d13, #3a210e), plus a 3-step gold band. The shaft carries alternating grain dots and a left-to-right cylindrical gradient. The outline is a dark brown (#251409, #3a210e) that leans toward the wood, not neutral black. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The 10 colours per tile is lower than the references' 17 and 20, and the 10 distinct colours is well below their 38-40. That is expected for a slim single-material post, so it is slightly lower in density but not a flat sticker.
